title: Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung für natürliche Personen 2025
why_needed: Official guide for the 2025 return: filing rules, deductions, deadlines and forms.
notes: Fixed 2026-10-13: was the baselland.ch listing page (HTTP 403 to scripts); now the direct PDF on bl-api.webcloud7.ch, the canton CMS file host. 48 pages, inner print code 2 W 2025 250730. Covers employed, self-employed and non-working persons. Deductions (Abzüge vom Einkommen) pp. 25 to 39, tacit 2-month extension p. 9, child deduction from the tax amount p. 37, crypto p. 47. No filing date printed; the date on the return or activation letter governs.

title: Steuererklärung für natürliche Personen 2025
why_needed: Main return form for natural persons; paper route and field reference.
notes: Fixed 2026-10-13: direct PDF instead of the blocked listing page. 4 pages; PDF title Int_2_2025_251030 (newer print than the 240816 in the file name). Paper form with signature lines; e-Tax BL filing needs no signature.

title: 2025 Informationen und Neuerungen
why_needed: Lists what changed for the 2025 return: pillar 3a and 3b, German property, mailings, extensions.
notes: Fetched and read. Print code suggests 2024-09-24, not printed on the page.

title: Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung 2026 für natürliche Personen
why_needed: Current-year guide; flags retroactive pillar 3a contributions for tax year 2025.
notes: Fetched and read. No stand date printed; print code suggests 2026-03-20.

title: Steuererklärung für natürliche Personen 2026
why_needed: Next year's main return form, for reference.
notes: Fixed 2026-10-13: direct PDF instead of the blocked listing page. 4 pages, print code Int_2_2026_260320, cover reads 2026.

title: Berufsauslagen 2025
why_needed: Professional expense deductions for employed persons: commuting, meals, other costs.
notes: Fetched and read. Flat rates apply, with actual costs via a Beiblatt and proof. Year field is for the filer to complete.

title: Angaben zum Abzug von Krankheits-, Unfall- und behinderungsbedingten Kosten 2025
why_needed: Medical, accident and disability cost deduction annex.
notes: Fixed 2026-10-13: direct PDF instead of the blocked listing page. 2 pages. Year-neutral form (print 2021, field: bitte Jahr eintragen), listed in the 2025 section.

title: Wertschriften- und Guthabenverzeichnis 2025
why_needed: Securities and bank balance annex, needed by most filers with assets.
notes: Fixed 2026-10-13: direct PDF instead of the blocked listing page. 4 pages; includes the Verrechnungssteuer refund request for Fälligkeiten 2025. The Ergänzungsblatt is a separate PDF in the same folder.

title: Wohn- und Geschäftsliegenschaften 2025
why_needed: Property annex for residential and commercial property owners.
notes: Fixed 2026-10-13: direct PDF instead of the blocked listing page. 2 pages, fillable, year-neutral (print 2022, field: bitte Jahr eintragen). The 2025 information page says owners receive the Liegenschaftsblatt separately.

title: Fristen und Termine (natürliche Personen)
why_needed: Ordinary filing deadlines by taxpayer type.
notes: Page gives 31 March (employed and non-working), 30 June (self-employed and legal entities), 30 November (secondary liability). Tax year not stated; the printed deadline on the return governs.

title: Fristverlängerung für Privatpersonen
why_needed: Automatic two-month extension, online request for longer, fee beyond two months.
notes: Page does not state which tax years it covers. Online form is at e-fristenprod.bl.ch (not fetched).

title: E-Tax BL
why_needed: Login, access codes, fully electronic submission without signature.
notes: Portal etax.bl.ch with password plus SMS code. Help at bl-support.etax.ch (not fetched). Page has no third-party software rules.

title: FAQ e-Tax BL
why_needed: Access code recovery, 72-hour correction window, commercial-use limit, software pointer.
notes: Says commercial use cannot raise the 20-return limit and points commercial users to Dr. Tax (Ringler Informatik AG). Verify wording. Links the e-filing ordinance SGS 331.21 (bl.clex.ch/data/331.21), which could not be read.

title: Informationen zur Steuererklärung 2025 (neu)
why_needed: Official change notice for the 2025 return: mailing, paper address, Liegenschaftsblatt.
notes: Page date 16.01.2026. Gives no filing deadline itself.

title: FAQ Quellensteuer
why_needed: Who is taxed at source, NOV deadline, what to do if the deduction is wrong.
notes: Fixed 2026-10-13: the FAQ page on baselland.ch answers HTTP 403 to scripts; this PDF on the canton CMS file host carries the same questions. 3 pages, created April 2024. NOV due 31 March of the following year, not extendable; wrong deduction: contact the employer; spouses of Swiss or C-permit holders are taxed ordinarily.

title: Antrag auf nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung (NOV) für Ansässige
why_needed: Form to request NOV for source-tax taxpayers resident in BL.
notes: Fixed 2026-10-13: the old baselland.ch URL returned HTTP 404; this is the file linked from the source-tax Formulare und Merkblätter page (file name says 2024, PDF modified 3 March 2026). 2 pages, tax year field blank. Deadline 31 March of the following year, not extendable (Verwirkungsfrist). A timely request cannot be withdrawn; residents then stay in NOV until source taxation ends.

title: Entscheidungsraster Tarif BL
why_needed: Source-tax tariff decision grid: which tariff applies to a person.
notes: PDF returned no machine-readable text, so its content and tax year are unknown. Read it manually or by OCR.

title: Steuerfüsse und Steuersätze der Einwohner- und Kirchgemeinden 2022 bis 2026
publisher: Amt für Daten und Statistik Basel-Landschaft
why_needed: Municipal tax rates by municipality; the table includes 2025 and 2026.
notes: Page is the entry to the table. Excel export linked at statistik.bl.ch/web_portal/export/20069, file type not verified. Official canton statistics site, not baselland.ch.

title: Steuerarten (allgemeine Informationen)
why_needed: Which cantonal, federal and municipal taxes are billed in which year.
notes: Lists cantonal 2026, federal 2025 and municipal 2026 billing. No tariff tables on the page.

title: Gesetz über die Staats- und Gemeindesteuern (Steuergesetz), SGS 331
why_needed: Governing law for income, wealth and source tax.
notes: Fixed 2026-10-13: the /frontend/versions/3502/download_pdf_file URL returned HTTP 404; the LexWork API serves the same version. 124 pages, Stand 1 January 2023. The bl.clex.ch API lists 3502 as the current version with no future version (checked 2026-10-13). Tariff in § 34.

title: Dekret zum Steuergesetz, SGS 331.1
why_needed: Implementing decree to the Steuergesetz; may hold deduction amounts.
notes: Fixed 2026-10-13: the /frontend/ URL returned HTTP 404; same version through the LexWork API. 10 pages, dated 19 February 2009, Stand 1 April 2011, still listed as current on bl.clex.ch.

title: Baselbieter Steuerbuch, Band 1 (Gesamtband)
why_needed: Official practice of the BL tax administration on income, deductions, social deductions and tariff.
notes: Fixed 2026-10-13: the index page answers HTTP 403 to scripts; Gesamtband 1 is linked from it and downloads (redirects to .../@@download/file/Steuerbuch BL_1.pdf). 286 pages, PDF modified 7 July 2026. Chapters 29 Nr. 1 to 21 cover commuting, meals, other job costs, training, childcare, 3a, insurance premiums, illness costs, donations; 33 and 34 cover social deductions, child deduction and tariff. Each chapter carries its own revision dates.

title: Tarife für die Staatssteuer, gültig ab 2025
why_needed: Cantonal income tax (Einheitstarif with and without Vollsplitting) and wealth tax rates for 2025.
notes: 2 pages, PDF created 20 September 2024. Income: extract of the tax amount table, single person and Vollsplitting. Wealth: bracket rates with a worked example. Linked from the Tarife page (Steuerzahlungen, Tarife).

title: Tarife für die Staatssteuer, gültig ab 2026
why_needed: Cantonal income and wealth tax rates for 2026.
notes: 2 pages, print code 457 2026jn 251212, PDF created 17 December 2025. Same layout as 2025; Vollsplitting now states a minimum rate (mindestens zum Minimalsteuersatz). The 2026 Informationen und Neuerungen say the income tariff was indexed for inflation.

title: Tabelle 2025 Einheitstarif (Tariftabelle 2025)
why_needed: Full 2025 income tariff table and the formula parameters (Eckwerte, Grenzsteuersatz) behind it.
notes: Excel 97 workbook (magic D0CF). Sheets hold Tarif A (Einzelperson) and Tarif B (Vollsplitting) with named formula parameters such as min_einkommen, medium_1, medium_2, max_einkommen. Read values in the workbook, not from the PDF extract.

title: Tabelle 2026 Einheitstarif (Tariftabelle 2026)
why_needed: Full 2026 income tariff table and formula parameters.
notes: Excel 97 workbook, same structure as 2025 (different content, sha256 differs). Linked from the Tarife 2026 block.

title: Anwendungsregeln zum neuen Steuertarif NP, gültig ab STJ 2007
why_needed: How the formula tariff is indexed and rounded: Vollsplitting divisor rounding, rate applied unrounded, final rounding to 5 centimes.
notes: 1 page, Word export dated February 2009; file name carries _2022 (copies _2020 and _2021 also exist). Index basis is the previous year June value of the consumer price index. Still the only rules document on the Tarife page.

title: Steuerfüsse und Steuersätze der Einwohner- und Kirchgemeinden 2022 bis 2026 (Export)
publisher: Amt für Daten und Statistik Basel-Landschaft
why_needed: Communal tax multipliers of every BL commune for 2026 (and 2022 to 2025), plus church tax rates.
notes: Export link on https://statistik.bl.ch/web_portal/18_4. Served as application/vnd.ms-excel but the body is an Excel HTML table (T_26_18_Steuerfuesse-Uebersicht), so the format is html. Natural persons columns 2022 to 2026; footnote: communal rate in percent of the Staatssteuer. The export id may change with the next edition.

title: Informationen und Neuerungen 2026
why_needed: Changes for tax year 2026: income tariff indexation, pensioner deduction, retroactive 3a, commuting rate, end of duplicate forms.
notes: 2 pages, print code 456 2026 260316. Also restates the free automatic 2-month extension and the CHF 40 online extension request (e-fristen.bl.ch).

title: Berufsauslagen 2026

notes: 2 pages, print code 459 2026jn 260316, year field left for the filer (bitte Jahr eintragen). Car mileage rate changed for 2026 per Informationen und Neuerungen 2026.

title: Verordnung zum Steuergesetz, SGS 331.11 (Stand 1. Januar 2025)
why_needed: Implementing rules in force for 2025, including employee professional expenses (§ 3) and rental value rules.
notes: 18 pages, version 4099, in force 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2025 per the bl.clex.ch API.

title: Verordnung zum Steuergesetz, SGS 331.11 (Stand 1. Januar 2026)
why_needed: Implementing rules in force from 2026; § 3 Abs. 1 lit. a Ziff. 3 (professional expenses) changed on 1 January 2026.
notes: 20 pages, version 4372, current version per the bl.clex.ch API (decision 2 December 2025). Change table: § 3 changed by GS 2025.057, § 14 by GS 2025.059.

title: Verordnung über die elektronische Einreichung der Steuererklärung für natürliche Personen, SGS 331.21
why_needed: Legal rules of e-Tax BL: signature-free filing, 2-factor login, 72-hour correction window, representation by handing over the access code.
notes: 5 pages, Stand 1 January 2023, current per the bl.clex.ch API. § 1 E-Tax BL from tax period 2022; § 2 access code and 2-factor authentication; § 5 72 hours; § 6 a third party may file with the taxpayer access code. No rule on third-party software.

title: Nutzungsbestimmungen E-Tax BL vom 12. Januar 2023
why_needed: Terms of use of the e-Tax BL portal: user duties, access blocking, liability.
notes: 4 pages, based on § 8 of SGS 331.21. Says access can be blocked for misuse; no approval rules for third-party software.

title: Verordnung zur Quellensteuer, SGS 331.16

title: Baselbieter Steuerbuch, Band 2 (Gesamtband)

Band 3 (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) not added.
